alternates.summary: Goodfire just launched what it says is a cheaper way to keep AI agents in check: Instead of paying a second AI to read everything an agent does, its monitors peek inside the model while it works and only call in backup when something looks fishy.
alternates.title: Goodfire says its new ‘inside-out’ monitors catch rogue AI agents at a fraction of the cost

alternates.summary: Anthropic's offering to help open-source projects track down security vulnerabilities with a new service called OSS Scanner. It says open-source projects that opt-in will get "thorough, periodic security scans by our strongest models at no cost." That could mean open-source projects get alerted about possible security issues sooner, but the trade-off is that OSS Scanner's […]
alternates.title: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects

articles.summary: Anthropic's updated usage policy explicitly prohibits users from repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases, though ordinary frustration and criticism are still allowed. The new rules also address election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance.
articles.title: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference

articles.summary: OpenAI’s most senior Asia-Pacific public policy executive is departing after six months in the job, according to a person familiar with the matter, just as the ChatGPT maker faces scrutiny from regulators in the region.
articles.title: OpenAI Asia-Pacific Policy Head to Leave After Six Months in Job

articles.summary: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.
articles.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses

articles.summary: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute allegations of mishandling sensitive information, warning in an open letter that their dismissals are creating a chilling effect on the company’s AI safety culture.
articles.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect

articles.summary: OpenAI's flood of proofs deviated from the guidelines set by a group of mathematical researchers consulted by the frontier lab.
articles.title: OpenAI’s math solutions aren’t meeting the field’s standards yet

articles.summary: Anthropic is making changes to its usage policy for the first time in over a year to reflect new and high-risk cases of misuse - including election interference, weapons development, surveillance, and health and financial uses. But one of the most significant changes prohibits "sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior" toward Claude. Last August, […]
articles.title: Anthropic bans ‘abusive or cruel behavior’ toward Claude

articles.summary: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.
articles.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected

articles.summary: OpenAI is expecting to reach or exceed $70 billion in annualized revenue by the end of the year, according to people familiar with the matter, driven largely by growth in its enterprise business.
articles.title: OpenAI Expects $70 Billion in Annualized Revenue by End of 2026
